metadata.title: Why SpaceX Stock Is Getting in the Way of a Tesla Merger<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Weak SpaceX Stock Is Complicating Elon Musk’s Merger Math
For many analysts and investors, the Tesla – SpaceX merger is a fait accompli. There is just one problem. SpaceX stock isn’t keeping up its part of the bargain.
